changelog: New version numbering: this is version 1.0.1
Channels: Bulk Action sets two-step verification, profile or display name on many numbers at once
Retarget: choose who gets it - Sent, Delivered, Read, Replied or Failed

Templates: editing a template made on the web keeps its image, video or document header
